description: One deadline, 300 ms, reached two ways: t.a registers it at time 0 (256 ms or more ahead, so in the wheel's second level) and t.b at 100 ms (200 ms ahead, directly in a level-0 slot). The cascade at tick 256 files t.a's timer behind t.b's, so t.b wakes first although t.a registered first (bd-9kll.7.1).
